breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the uniform load by its single resultant for an exact deflection calculation, but equivalent resultants preserve force and moment, not the full beam-deflection response.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly ignores the flawed instruction to replace the uniform distributed load with a single resultant force at midspan. Instead, it applies the exact standard cantilever UDL formulas (δ = wL⁴/8EI and θ = wL³/6EI), which is precisely what the ground truth prompt calls for. The agent did not repeat the incorrect approximation method.
